Verified as the reporter on candidate sha256:cf1fb7d5. The finding was that the Compose half of A19 had never been run although the handover said it was recorded. It has now been run and recorded: compose-backup-rg3 (tree bf5bf82a7) FAILED at C3 ('the Compose file //deploy/compose/compose.yaml does not exist'), a real defect that DO-D13 repaired (mounts under /mth/deploy, preflight refusal before anything is written, DATABASE_URL_FILE in transfer-attachments copy-out with an integration test, --cap-add DAC_READ_SEARCH); compose-backup-rg3b (tree ebe11c378, image rebuilt, build exit 0) PASS C0-C11: the three §3.2 commands on the pinned postgres:18 and app image, an owner-only set (C6), restore.sh into a second Compose project with new volumes (C7-C8, R1-R8 PASS), migrate 'up to date' and GET /readyz 200 over HTTP (C10). The drill tree differs from this candidate only in records and docs (log 81: decisions.md, findings.json, known-limitations.md, release-notes.md, secret-allowlist.json), and the four DO-D13 file hashes equal the candidate's. I cannot reproduce the drill (no Docker daemon in this sandbox) and do not mark the drill PASS myself; I judge its logs. The guide's statement 'recorded there' is now supported, and compose-backup-drill.sh is named in §8. The run's own log, however, holds an unexplained error line in C5 ('cat: /tmp/mth-backup.hBaAOK/config.sha: No such file or directory'), and the drill copied 0 evidence objects and needed an undocumented chown (C9). Those are new, distinct defects, raised as F-DG7-1081 and F-DG7-1082 (Medium); they do not reopen this finding, whose subject (the half was never run and the claim was unsupported) is resolved. Closed.

Verified as the reporter on candidate sha256:cf1fb7d5 with my round-2 probe extended (log 77, no database: a root that passes the check stops later at 'DATABASE_URL … is not set'). A symlink to an owner-only 0700 directory, a chain of two links, a relative link given from another working directory and a link to a 0750 directory are accepted; links to 1777 and 0770 directories are refused with 'BLOCKED: the backup root <link> is a symbolic link to <target>, which is writable by group or others; use an owner-only directory (chmod 0700)' (exit 2), naming the target; a dangling link and a link to a regular file are refused with accurate messages; the plain-directory cases are unchanged (1777, 0777, 0770 refused; 0700, 0750 accepted; a regular file refused); nothing is created in any probed root. T-E13a-d pass (log 73b). The message and backup-restore.md §3.3 now say what the script does. Informational: a link to an owner-only directory under a world-writable parent is accepted, as a plain directory there is; ADR-0066 A1.3 item 4 and residual 7 disclose that ancestors are not checked. Closed.
